verses.1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.2: He was with God in the beginning.
verses.3: Through him all things were made; without him nothing that has been made has been made.
verses.4: In him was life, and that life was the light that gives light to every man.
verses.5: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
verses.6: There was a man whom God sent, and he found his name.
verses.7: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all men might believe.
verses.8: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
verses.9: The true light that gives light to every man was coming into the world.
verses.10: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
verses.11: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
verses.12: Yet to all who received him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God-
verses.13: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.
verses.14: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We have seen him, who is like the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.15: This is the one I meant when I said, 'A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.' "
verses.16: From the fullness of his grace we have all received one blessing after another.
verses.17: For the law was given through Moses and Aaron, but the truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.18: No one has ever seen God, but God the One and Only, who is at the Father's side, has made him known.
verses.19: Now this was the testimony of John when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to him to ask him who he was.
verses.20: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Christ".
verses.21: "Then who are you? " they asked". Are you Elijah? " He said, "No".
verses.22: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
verses.23: John replied, "I am the voice of one calling in the desert,' Do what is right in the eyes of the Lord. '"
verses.24: Now one of those who had been sent out was a Pharisee.
verses.25: questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the promised one?"
verses.26: He replied, "I give you water. " But there stood one among them who did not know who he was.
verses.27: He is the one who comes after me, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie".
verses.28: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where Jesus was staying.
verses.29: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Son of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.30: This is the one I meant when I said, 'A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'
verses.31: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing in water was that he might be revealed to Israel".
verses.32: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
verses.33: I would not have known him, except that the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, 'The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.'
verses.34: I have seen and I testify that this man is the Son of God".
verses.35: The next day Jesus saw him again standing there with his two disciples.
verses.36: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Son of God!"
verses.37: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
verses.38: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want? " They answered", Rabbi " (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"
verses.39: "Come, " he replied", and you will see. " So they went and saw him, and spent that day with him. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.40: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who heard what he said and who followed him.
verses.41: The first thing he did was to find his own brothers and tell them, "We have found the Messiah " (that is, the Christ).
verses.42: Then he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, "You are the son of Joseph. You will be called Cephas " (which, when translated, is Peter).
verses.43: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, "Follow me".
verses.44: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethany.
verses.45: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote - Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph".
verses.46: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there? " Nathanael asked". Come and see, " said Philip.
verses.47: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is nothing false".
verses.48: "How do you know me? " Nathanael asked. Jesus answered", I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you".
verses.49: Then Nathanael declared, "Sir, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel".
verses.50: Jesus said, "You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You shall see greater things than that".
verses.51: He then added, "I tell you the truth, you shall see the earth open, and the clouds of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man".
